TITLE:
The arrow behind the glass —
why does it flip?
NEXT:
Turn a cup upside down
and the water stays in?

EN.투명한 컵에\n물을 가득 채워요:
Fill a clear glass
all the way with water
EN.컵을 화면 앞\n한 뼘쯤에 들어요:
Hold it about a hand's width
in front of the screen
EN.컵 너머로\n화면 속 화살표를 봐요:
Look through the glass
at the arrow on the screen
EN.깨지지 않는\n플라스틱 컵이면 더 좋아요:
An unbreakable
plastic cup is even better
EN.화살표는 오른쪽 →\n이제 컵을 앞에 대 봐요:
The arrow points right →
Now hold the glass in front
EN.컵을 천천히\n앞뒤로 움직여 봐요:
Slowly move the glass
forward and back
EN.컵 속 화살표는\n어느 쪽을 가리키나요?:
Which way does the arrow
in the glass point?
EN.컵 속에선 왼쪽 ←\n반대로 뒤집혔어요!:
In the glass it points left ←
It flipped!
EN.위아래는 그대로,\n왼쪽 · 오른쪽만 바뀌어요:
Up and down stay the same —
only left and right swap
EN.컵이 너무 가까우면 그대로예요\n거리를 바꿔 봐요:
Too close and it won't flip —
try changing the distance
EN.위에서 내려다본 모습이에요\n화면 · 물컵 · 눈:
Here's the view from above:
screen · glass · eye
EN.빛은 물에 들어갈 때 · 나올 때\n꺾여요:
Light bends when it goes
into water and when it comes out
EN.꺾인 빛이 컵 속에서\n엇갈려요!:
The bent rays
cross inside the glass!
EN.그래서 왼쪽 빛은 오른쪽에서,\n오른쪽 빛은 왼쪽에서 와요:
So light from the left arrives from the right,
and light from the right arrives from the left
EN.둥근 물컵이 볼록 렌즈처럼\n화살표를 뒤집은 거예요:
The round glass acts like a convex lens
and flips the arrow
EN.돋보기로 먼 곳을 보면\n거꾸로 보이는 것도 같은 이유!:
That's also why faraway things look
upside down through a magnifying glass!
EN.물컵 하나로 해 봐요!: Try it with just a glass of water!
